CustomField.formula: IF( MargenOperacion__c < 0.18, IMAGE("/resource/redCircle", 'rojo' , 10, 10) + " MARGEN BAJO (" + RIGHT(TEXT(FLOOR(MargenOperacion__c * 100)), 2) & "," & IF( MOD(MargenOperacion__c * 100, 1) * 100 < 10, "0" & TEXT(ROUND(MOD(MargenOperacion__c * 100, 1), 2) * 100), TEXT(MIN(ROUND(MOD(MargenOperacion__c * 100, 1), 2) * 100, 99)) ) & "%)", IMAGE("/resource/greenCircle", "verde" , 10, 10) + " OK!")
CustomField.label: Alerta Margen Bajo
